''See also: [[Aether Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Aether is a fundamental, omnipresent force that exists above and beneath physical reality. It acts as the essential medium for magic, allowing spells to function even in a vacuum. While its true nature remains a subject of debate, one theory suggests it consists of energy leaking from other dimensions. The Aether can manifest as physical phenomena, such as concentrated magic in the sky that blots out the sun, or as tangible [[constructs]] like serpents, [[dragons]], and elemental energy bolts. It also serves as the basis for spirits, which are non-biological manifestations of the Aether that take on physical forms when tuned to specific concepts. Beyond its role in magic, the Aether is integral to planetary development; strong local flows can facilitate the creation of a [[World Spirit]] and sustain habitable atmospheres. It is also the foundation for [[Aethertech]], an advanced technology used to create everything from massive starships and subspace engines to specialized tools like grand [[fabricators]] that can replicate almost any material. The Aether behaves like a current that reflects the shape of the galaxy, and its movements can be read to gain insights into magic or navigation. Some believe the Aether possesses a form of awareness, potentially reacting to the actions of people or responding to large-[[scale]] extradimensional threats.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Aether is a sentient force and magical medium that can be manipulated through symbols, natural patterns, or the [[resonance]] of specific words. While it serves as the energy source for manifesting spells and powering devices, it can also be twisted into intricate designs, poured like [[water]], or used to conjure substances such as dark [[water]]. This force reacts to human resolve and identity, allowing individuals to define their magical nature through it or even use it to bring possible lives into reality. During massive conflicts, the Aether churns like a stormy sea, yet it remains a medium capable of carrying sound, witnessing moments, or even facilitating movement through the void.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Though insulted by [[the Advocates]], the Aether is a complex force that can be manipulated to conjure [[dragons]] or red fire. This substance, which can be dispersed by proprietary alloys and is naturally thinner in certain spaces, serves as the essential support for Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's [[Combat Art]] and the foundation of all truth spells. It acts as a current reflecting the shape of the galaxy, capable of providing memories of alternate selves and responding to [[Starhammer]]'s desire for power. While the [[Zenith Device]] can bend it to break reality, the Aether remains a function that supersedes natural logic and holds the sole knowledge of the outcome of [[Starhammer]]'s battle.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Aether serves as a medium through which the [[Visiri]] third eye perceives life energy and where sounds like shattering porcelain can be heard. This force, which is found as a resource on certain planets, can churn like a stormy sea during magical conflicts and possesses the ability to awaken [[Zenith Devices]]. While wizards work with it directly and Archmages explore its depths, Elementalists use the Aether to conjure and control various elements. The entity can hear Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's wishes, answer the Captain's inquiries regarding worst-case scenarios, and even bend Fate{{!}}fate. Although its strength weakens inside the [[Shadow Ark]], it has taught Kyri Prest{{!}}Kyri hard lessons and prepared the Captain for upcoming threats.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Aether is invoked during the signing of contracts and serves as the source of [[Melerius]]'s prompting. This force can exert telekinetic pressure, ignite with magical symbols during moments of anger, and manifest as golden yellow flames in response to Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax. It possesses the power to awaken the [[Zenith Devices]] for a unified purpose and can be used to freeze air or lock [[ritual]] items in place. While it views individuals through the lens of their stories and actions, an approaching apocalypse has recently disturbed its state and caused a shift as the narrator was redefined.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Aether]] is responsible for the inability to kill certain people.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30">''The Pilot'', chapter 30</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Aether]] was used to lock [[ritual]] items in place.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c34">''The Pilot'', chapter 34</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] wishes to be baptized in the [[Aether]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c40">''The Pilot'', chapter 40</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Aethril eyes]] allow the user to see the flow of the [[Aether]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c40" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Combat Arts]] and spells both require actions that resonate with the [[Aether]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c45">''The Pilot'', chapter 45</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|An approaching apocalyptic event has disturbed the [[Aether]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48">''The Pilot'', chapter 48</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Aether]] shifted as the narrator was redefined.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“It’s the will of the Aether!” he exclaimed.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“It’s the genuine Zenith Starship, I swear on the Aether,” I said. That’s not a binding vow, but wizards were still wary of breaking it.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The “life energy” they see is a reflection of a person’s power and vitality through the Aether.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c1" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“Why did the Aether awaken us if we can’t work together?”<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c23" />}}
